policy.purpose: Educational self-reflection; no diagnosis, hiring, or high-stakes decisions.
policy.scoring: Scores are within-questionnaire descriptive indices, not percentiles or calibrated probabilities.
policy.validation: No reliability, factor-structure, test-retest, criterion-validity, or held-out validation has yet been conducted on these custom question sets.
policy.independence: Commercial instrument items are not copied; Big Five items are original and are not the BFI-2 or IPIP scale.

models.name: Big Five / Five-Factor Model
models.methods: Continuous trait dimensions are more faithful to the Big Five tradition than categorical types. This studio currently uses a brief original item set; its domain coverage is uneven and is not normed. Reverse-keyed items are reverse-scored, and raw scores are shown only as within-set indicators.
gaps: Custom items have not been psychometrically validated.
No age, language, culture, or reference-population norms.
Do not interpret a 0–100 display as a percentile or objective probability.

models.name: Myers-Briggs Type Indicator framework
models.methods: The commercial MBTI instrument is distinct from this independent, original forced-choice explorer. The current result is a preference hypothesis, not an official MBTI administration. Forced-choice responses and a four-letter cutoff can hide continuous or contextual variation; close margins must be surfaced.
gaps: No official MBTI items, scoring tables, or practitioner process are reproduced.
No validated preference scales, norms, or test-retest study.
Type labels must not imply ability, performance, or fixed identity.

models.name: DISC behavioral-style framework
models.methods: The current exercise uses original situational forced-choice options. The result is the distribution of choices in this particular item set, not an Everything DiSC score or a validated style classification. Forced-choice options are ipsative: selecting one response necessarily excludes others.
gaps: Not the commercial Everything DiSC assessment or its eight-scale model.
No reliability, validity, norming, or criterion study.
Style may vary by situation; ties and close scores should remain ambiguous.

sources.title: International Personality Item Pool (IPIP)
sources.license: IPIP items are stated by the site to be public domain; individual instruments and implementations still require checking.
sources.supports: Public-domain personality item resources and scale documentation. The current custom items are not copied from IPIP.
sources.limits: Availability of public-domain items does not validate this studio's custom questionnaire.

sources.title: Soto & John (2017), The next Big Five Inventory-2
sources.license: Research article; the BFI-2 itself is copyrighted and is not reproduced here.
sources.supports: The BFI-2 is a 60-item domain-and-facet measure with a published development/validation paper.
sources.limits: Evidence for BFI-2 does not transfer to these original questions.

sources.title: Soto & John (2017), BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS
sources.license: Article citation only; questionnaire items are not copied.
sources.supports: The published 30-item short form balances efficiency against reliability and validity.
sources.limits: Our questions are not the BFI-2-S and have no demonstrated equivalent properties.

sources.title: Myers & Briggs Foundation — Reliability and Validity
sources.license: Official instrument and item content are protected; this project does not reproduce them.
sources.supports: Official source for the MBTI instrument's own validity/reliability claims and the distinction between preference categories and continuous trait scales.
sources.limits: Publisher-authored source; not independent validation of this studio.

sources.title: Myers & Briggs Foundation — MBTI Code of Ethics
sources.license: Reference link; no protected items reproduced.
sources.supports: Use nonjudgmental language, avoid overgeneralization, and do not use MBTI to screen job applicants.
sources.limits: Ethical guidance is not a validation study for this tool.

sources.title: Everything DiSC — The Science Behind DiSC
sources.license: Commercial instrument materials are not reproduced.
sources.supports: Vendor-published account of reliability/validity methods and eight-scale Everything DiSC model.
sources.limits: Vendor-authored claims should be read as such; these results cannot be transferred to this custom questionnaire.
